ebitda.loc: Investor Update 4Q2020, PDF p. 3, full-year 2020 column - EBITDA
ebitda.note: EBITDA as the company reports it in its 4Q investor update (US$ mn, 1 dp). The update gives no definition; the FS capital-risk note (e.g. FS2025 Note 35b, PDF p. 115) defines EBITDA as consolidated profit before tax added back with interest, depreciation and amortisation, excluding gains/losses on disposal of fixed assets, one-off items, investment write-offs and FX gains/losses. The 2020 figure excludes the US$165.8m net reversal of mining-property impairment (IU footnote *1 relates it to NPAT only).

operating_profit.loc: AR2021 PDF p. 6 (printed p. 4), Financial Highlights and Ratios - Laba Usaha / Operating Profit
operating_profit.note: The FS face has no operating-profit line (gross profit -> selling, G&A, finance, other -> profit before tax); this is the AR 'Laba Usaha / Operating Profit'. Arithmetic check on the FS: it equals profit before tax plus finance expenses and also excludes the US$165,864,761 reversal of mining-property impairment, so it includes finance income, FX and other items (it is NOT gross profit less selling and G&A).

validation_ack.reason: Rounding, not a share-basis error: FY2022 basic EPS is printed only to 2 decimals (US$0.07 in FS2022 PDF p. 12, FS2023 and AR2022-AR2024). 0.07 x 33,333,335,000 = US$2,333m vs attributable profit US$2,178.5m; unrounded EPS = 0.0654 (weighted shares 33,333,335,000, FS2022 Note 29). No document prints FY2022 EPS with more decimals.

research_notes: Reporting currency: the audited consolidated FS are presented in US dollars ('Expressed in United States Dollars'); all money values are USD million (US$ as printed / 1e6). DPS values are rupiah as paid (declared in US$, converted at the BI middle rate on each recording date); dividend 'total' is in USD million as approved.
Name: no rename since listing (12 Aug 2008); the current legal name in FS 9M2026 and AR2025 is PT Bayan Resources Tbk. Controlling shareholder: Dato' Dr. Low Tuck Kwong.

Source policy: revenue, profit, balance-sheet levels, cash flows, shares and FX rate come from each year's own audited FS (bayan.com.sg). Exceptions: FY2023 cash uses the FS2024 reclassified comparative (DHE export-proceeds placements moved from restricted cash into cash and cash equivalents, FS2024 Note 38); FY2023 EPS (0.037) is from AR2025 and FY2024 EPS (0.028) from the FS2025 comparative because the own-year FS round EPS to 2 decimals (0.04 / 0.03), which would break the EPS x shares check by 7-8%.

Operating profit: the FS face has no 'laba usaha' line. The stored values are the AR Financial Highlights 'Laba Usaha / Operating Profit'; on the FS figures this equals profit before tax plus finance expenses (2020 additionally excludes the US$165.9m reversal of mining-property impairment). It therefore includes finance income, FX and other items and is not comparable with a 'gross profit less opex' definition. A reviewer who prefers the strict 'FS line only' rule should null these six values.

EBITDA comes from the 4Q investor updates (company releases, US$ mn with 1 decimal); the FS capital-risk note gives the definition (PBT + interest + D&A, excluding disposal gains/losses, one-offs, investment write-offs and FX). FY2021 EBITDA (1,743.0) is the same in the 4Q21 and 4Q22 updates.

Restatement/reclassification: FS2022 reclassified barging expense from selling expenses to cost of revenue for 2021 (2021 gross profit 1,901.1 -> 1,746.5, IU 4Q22 footnote); revenue, profit, operating profit and EBITDA are unaffected. FS2024 reclassified 2023 cash (see above).

Stock split 1:10, ex-date (first regular-market day at Rp10 nominal) 2022-12-02 (KSEI-22755/JKU/1122; AR2022 p. 11). share_basis: FY2020-FY2021 EPS, shares and year-end prices (AR2021, published May 2022) and the FY2020-FY2021 final dividends are pre-split; everything from FY2022 on is post-split. No rights issue, bonus issue or reverse split since 2019 (share count 3,333,333,500 until the split, 33,333,335,000 after; KSEI corporate-action list shows only cash dividends and the 'Mandatory Conversion 1 BYAN : 10 BYAN').

Dividends: FY2020 and FY2021 single finals; FY2022, FY2023 and FY2024 an interim (declared in December out of 9M profit, paid in January) plus a final; FY2025 a single final of US$500,000,025 (AGMS 2026-06-10, paid 2026-07-08). Payout ratios are null for FY2022-FY2025 because the company prints only per-payment percentages on different bases (interim vs 9M profit, final vs full-year profit) or none at all; FY2020 91.3% and FY2021 82.5% are as printed.
FY2020 DPS conflict: KSEI (BI rate Rp14,292 on 2021-06-02) and the company dividend page give Rp1,286.28; AR2021 and AR2022 print Rp1,284.84. The KSEI/dividend-page value is stored.
FY2020 profit includes a US$165.9m net reversal of mining-property impairment (FS2020 PDF p. 8); EBITDA and AR operating profit exclude it.

Debt history: US$400m 6.125% Senior Notes due 2023 issued Jan 2020 (FS2020 Note 18) and redeemed early in 2021 (US$26.5m early-redemption cost, FS2021 cash flow); otherwise only short-term bank loans/working-capital facilities (2019 US$363.6m, 2023 US$396.9m, 2024 US$337.5m, 30 Sep 2026 US$148.6m; nil at YE 2021, 2022, 2025).

FY2025 and 9M2026: a disposal group is classified as held for sale (FS2025 Note 30q: MoU of 11 Dec 2025 to sell a Company asset, US$80m deposit received); its assets (US$73.6m incl. US$14.2m cash) are outside the stored cash. In Oct 2025 Bayan placed US$179.1m in IDR 'Patriot Bonds' (2% coupon), shown as investment in bonds, not cash.

Operating statistics (production, sales volume, ASP, cash cost) are from the 4Q investor update summary tables; 'MT' there means million tonnes. Cash costs include royalty, barging and SG&A (IU 4Q25 p. 14). AR2025 prints three different 2025 ASPs (48.4 / 48.1 / 47.93 US$/MT); the investor-update 48.4 (= AR MD&A) is stored.

ROE/ROA are the AR ratios 'Laba Tahun Berjalan terhadap Ekuitas / Total Aset': profit for the year including NCI over year-end (not average) equity/assets. The AR's English label for the equity ratio is 'Return of Capital Employed'.
